author.name: Linda Ellerbee
author.heading: About Linda Ellerbee
author.bio: Linda Ellerbee worked in television news on NBC News Overnight and Our World, and later created and hosted Nick News. Her memoirs include And So It Goes and Move On: Adventures in the Real World.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Ellerbee’s memoir ranges across changes in television, politics and her own life. The longer formulation distinguishes changing fashions from a more durable sense of personal style; the evidence for this attribution is a specific book citation rather than a surviving Sontag source.
